Refactored [GraphView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R001_module_java/GraphView.java:8) to make it self-contained and instance-based.

Previously `GraphView` kept its frame, panel, and labels in static fields even though callers created it as an object. That made the view effectively global and harder to reason about. It now uses normal instance fields, builds the Swing frame through its own `JFrame` superclass, and keeps graph series colors in a deterministic `LinkedHashMap`.

I also tightened the inner `GraphPanel` API by making helper methods private, adding `@Override` annotations, and handling series-count changes without relying on shared static state.
